parsedContent.headline: You answered only 2 of 47 questions; the biggest need is mastering basic logistics and inventory concepts.
topConcepts: Warehouse management system functions and key logistics documents
tips: Review the definitions and uses of barcodes, RFID, and WMS; create a one‑page cheat sheet of each term.
Practice break‑even, contribution margin, and EOQ formulas with varied numeric examples.
Learn the purpose of key logistics documents (shipping manifest, release order, cycle‑count sheet) and quiz yourself on their names.
Work through safety stock and reorder point problems to solidify lead‑time calculations.
Do timed multiple‑choice drills on basic logistics concepts to build confidence and reduce unanswered questions.
